title: FlashMove
tagline: Tool to Move tokens  between multiple blockchains , from Ethereum to Matic
description:
Tool to Move tokens  between multiple blockchains 

Due to lack of time , we only achieve scripts to transfer ETH and KRM ERC20 from Ethereum to Polygon, 

We don't use Polygon SDK but hardhat scripts to interact with Polygon bridge 

Tests has been achieved between Goerli and Mumbai testnets.
how_its_made:
Javascript scripts allowing interaction with Polygon Bridge



Use of Solidity +  HardHat + Polygon Bridge smart contracts infrastructure



One script to transfer ETH form one blockchain to the other

One script to transfer our Kredeum KRM token  form one blockchain to the other



Din't get time to test transfer of ERC721 token, but we will do later on our Kredeum NFTs project
